provider.name: QAF-035 QA/beta provider
provider.accountScope: QA/beta Xtream provider account used for the 300-500 live-user beta. Credentials are intentionally not recorded in this artifact.
provider.ownerRole: Lumen beta, provider/XUI, capacity, rollback/throttle, and decision owner
provider.contact: Filip direct beta escalation channel; private contact details are not recorded in release artifacts.
provider.notes: Ja, Filip, kao owner Lumen beta testiranja i provider/XUI pristupa, potvrđujem da je isti account/upstream dozvoljen za kontrolisani beta test do 300-500 korisnika. Potvrđujem da beta ne sme koristiti XUI-side transcode/remux/generated-HLS workaround bez moje eksplicitne odluke. U slučaju 401/403/429/5xx eskalacije, playback regresije ili provider overload-a, ja sam decision owner za stop/throttle/rollback.

target.trafficModel: Live TV beta cohort with normal channel zapping and catch-up attempts kept on provider media bytes.

forbiddenResolutionPaths: Do not resolve broken catch-up channels with local ffmpeg or ffprobe.
Do not resolve broken catch-up channels with server-side media processing, transcode, remux, generated HLS, proxy-remuxed, or remux-hls.
Do not resolve broken catch-up channels with XUI-side media processing, XUI-side transcode, or XUI-side remux.
mediaProcessingCommitment.notes: Filip approved the beta no-media-processing policy: no local ffmpeg/ffprobe, server-side transcode/remux, generated HLS, proxy-remuxed, remux-hls, or XUI-side transcode/remux workaround without explicit owner decision.

capacityCommitment.accountLimitEvidence: Filip owner statement approves the same provider/XUI account and upstream for controlled 300-500-user beta use.
capacityCommitment.upstreamCapacityEvidence: Owner-approved controlled beta range: 300-500 live users, with stop/throttle on provider overload or 401/403/429/5xx escalation.
capacityCommitment.rateLimitPolicy: Stop new beta enrollment on provider 429/5xx burst, auth/live-stream 401/403 escalation, provider overload, playback regression, or no-media-processing policy violation.
capacityCommitment.rollbackContact: Filip is the rollback/throttle decision owner and direct escalation contact.
capacityCommitment.notes: This is owner/provider approval for the controlled beta range, not a substitute for manual real-device QA or separate Lumen edge load evidence.
